During the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] '''Bem Lyu'kij''' was a member of the [[Bothan Combat Response Element]] which was watching over the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. Specifically, Lyu'kij was tracking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces still in the sector, such as [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].
